title: Forecrew tool catalog entry
description: Schema of packs/catalog/<name>.yaml: a well-known MCP server or command-line tool the advisor may suggest (decision 24). The advisor only ever suggests tools from the catalog; anything else is named in a rationale as worth researching. Entries never hold secrets: credentials names the variables a human sets up.

name.description: Equal to the file name without .yaml (domain.ValidName).

kind.description: mcp_server: an MCP server a toolbox can start; cli: a command-line tool a toolbox can install.

purpose.description: What it does, in one or two sentences.

install.description: How a toolbox gets it, e.g. a package and version or an image.

license.description: SPDX license identifier, e.g. Apache-2.0, or NOASSERTION.

credentials.description: Names of the variables it needs, which a human configures; never values.
